title.narrative: Upgrading the Two-State Solution Coalition - TSC

description.narrative: The action aims at strengthening the effectiveness and upgrade the efforts of the existing Two State Coalition (TSC) and its members, turning the united network of peace CSOs, built in the first iteration of the project, into a powerful advocacy force for the two-state solution. By strengthening the voice, capacity and policy shaping efforts of its members, the TSC aims to broaden support for the two-state solution at local, national, and international levels.
